result.instructions: Tools for WaiverFile, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Who signed a waiver for tomorrow's events?"; "How many waivers were signed last month?"; "Find the waiver signed by jane@example.com.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes WaiverFile data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run waiverfile_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run waiverfile_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run waiverfile_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. waiverfile_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: waiverfile_get_site
tools.title: Get site details
tools.description: Details of the WaiverFile site (WaiverSite) this API key belongs to: name, settings and plan information as WaiverFile reports them. GET /GetSiteDetails.

tools.name: waiverfile_list_waiver_forms
tools.title: List waiver forms
tools.description: List the waiver forms of the site (name, id, which fields they collect: email, address, phone, date of birth, minimum age, signature). Active forms by default; set include_deleted for all forms including deleted ones. Use the form ids when creating or updating events. GET /GetActiveWaiverForms or /GetAllWaiverForms.

tools.name: waiverfile_list_events
tools.title: List events by date range
tools.description: List waiver events (a class, tour, party or session that collects waivers) whose date falls in a range, optionally only one event category. Each event has an id, name, start/end, headcount and spots remaining. Dates are UTC. GET /GetEventsByDateRange or /GetEventsByCategory.

start.description: Start of the range: yyyy-mm-dd (00:00 UTC) or an ISO 8601 date-time with timezone, e.g. 2026-10-01T00:00:00Z.

end.description: End of the range: yyyy-mm-dd means 00:00 UTC of that day, so pass the next day to include the whole day.

category_id.description: Only events of this event category id (from waiverfile_list_event_categories).

tools.name: waiverfile_list_upcoming_events
tools.title: List upcoming events
tools.description: List upcoming waiver events between two dates (UTC), for example the next 7 days. GET /GetUpcomingEvents.

start.description: Start of the range: yyyy-mm-dd (00:00 UTC) or an ISO 8601 date-time with timezone, e.g. 2026-10-01T00:00:00Z.

end.description: End of the range: yyyy-mm-dd means 00:00 UTC of that day, so pass the next day to include the whole day.

tools.name: waiverfile_list_event_categories
tools.title: List event categories
tools.description: List the event categories of the site (id and name). Use the ids to filter events or to put a new event in a category. GET /GetEventCategories.

tools.name: waiverfile_get_event_waivers
tools.title: Get waivers for an event
tools.description: The waivers collected for one event: who signed, when, and the participants. Personal data of signers. GET /GetWaiversForEvent.

tools.name: waiverfile_search_waivers
tools.title: Search waivers
tools.description: Search signed waivers by free-text terms (a signer's name, email or phone). Personal data of signers. GET /SearchWaivers.

terms.description: Search terms, for example a name or an email address.

tools.name: waiverfile_get_waiver
tools.title: Get a waiver
tools.description: One signed waiver by id: signer, date signed, participants, collected form data, event and the agreement text. Set lite for only the collected form data (no agreement text or event info). Signature and image bytes are never returned. GET /GetWaiver or /GetWaiverLite.

lite.description: Only the collected form data, without agreement text or event info (default false).

tools.name: waiverfile_find_waivers_by_reference
tools.title: Find waivers by reference id
tools.description: Find waivers by the reference ids an outside booking or reservation system attached to them (referenceID1, 2, 3). Give at least one of reference_id_1/2/3, or reference_id_any to match all three fields. GET /GetWaiversByReferenceID.

reference_id_any.description: Match any of the three reference id fields.

tools.name: waiverfile_list_waivers
tools.title: List waivers by date range
tools.description: A page of the waivers signed in a date range. Set lite for only the collected form data (smaller). For a flat export with custom form columns use waiverfile_export_waiver_data; for totals use waiverfile_count_waivers. Personal data of signers. GET /GetAllWaiversByDateRange or /GetAllWaiversByDateRangeLite.

start.description: Start of the range: yyyy-mm-dd (00:00 UTC) or an ISO 8601 date-time with timezone, e.g. 2026-10-01T00:00:00Z.

end.description: End of the range: yyyy-mm-dd means 00:00 UTC of that day, so pass the next day to include the whole day.

lite.description: Only the collected form data, without agreement text or event info (default false).

page_index.description: Page index (default 0). WaiverFile does not state whether the first page is 0 or 1; if page 0 looks like it skips data or is empty while the count is not, try 1.

tools.name: waiverfile_export_waiver_data
tools.title: Export waiver data
tools.description: A page of flat waiver rows for a date range (the data behind the WaiverFile export): standard fields, optionally every custom form field as a column, and participants either as one comma-separated column or one row each. Personal data of signers. GET /GetWaiverData.

start.description: Start of the range: yyyy-mm-dd (00:00 UTC) or an ISO 8601 date-time with timezone, e.g. 2026-10-01T00:00:00Z.

end.description: End of the range: yyyy-mm-dd means 00:00 UTC of that day, so pass the next day to include the whole day.

include_custom_columns.description: Include the custom form fields of all waiver forms (default false: standard fields only).

consolidate_participants.description: true (default) = one row per waiver with participant names in one column; false = full participant information, one row per participant.

page_index.description: Page index (default 0). WaiverFile does not state whether the first page is 0 or 1; if page 0 looks like it skips data or is empty while the count is not, try 1.

tools.name: waiverfile_count_waivers
tools.title: Count waivers in a date range
tools.description: How many waivers a date range holds: record_count (GetWaiverDataCount, the rows waiverfile_export_waiver_data pages through) and waiver_count (GetAllWaiversByDateRangePageCount, which WaiverFile documents as the number of waivers in the range, used to work out the pages of waiverfile_list_waivers). pages_at_page_size is waiver_count divided by page_size (default 25), rounded up. GET /GetWaiverDataCount and /GetAllWaiversByDateRangePageCount.

start.description: Start of the range: yyyy-mm-dd (00:00 UTC) or an ISO 8601 date-time with timezone, e.g. 2026-10-01T00:00:00Z.

end.description: End of the range: yyyy-mm-dd means 00:00 UTC of that day, so pass the next day to include the whole day.

annotations.title: Count waivers in a date range

tools.name: waiverfile_list_sms_subscribers
tools.title: List SMS subscribers
tools.description: SMS marketing subscribers (phone numbers) that opted in during a date range, or with opted_out set the ones that opted out. Dates are UTC. Personal data. GET /GetSubscribersByDate or /GetOptedOutSubscribersByOptOutDate.

start.description: Start of the range: yyyy-mm-dd (00:00 UTC) or an ISO 8601 date-time with timezone, e.g. 2026-10-01T00:00:00Z.

end.description: End of the range: yyyy-mm-dd means 00:00 UTC of that day, so pass the next day to include the whole day.

opted_out.description: List subscribers that opted OUT in the range instead of opted in (default false).

tools.name: waiverfile_create_event
tools.title: Create an event
tools.description: Create a waiver event (a class, tour or session that collects waivers) with a name and a start/end time (UTC). Optionally an all-day flag, category, location, signing cut-off, participant limit and which waiver forms to attach (default: WaiverFile's own choice, see list_waiver_forms). Not idempotent: calling twice creates two events. Sends no email. POST /InsertEvent.

start.description: Event start (UTC): yyyy-mm-dd or ISO 8601 date-time with timezone.

end.description: Event end (UTC), not before the start.

signing_cutoff.description: Last moment a waiver can be signed for this event.

tools.name: waiverfile_update_event
tools.title: Update an event
tools.description: Update an existing event. WaiverFile replaces the whole event, so name, start, end and all_day are required and anything left out is reset: category_id empty = no category, waiver_form_ids empty = ALL active forms are attached. Read the event first (waiverfile_list_events) and send its current values for the fields you do not change. Same input twice gives the same result. POST /UpdateEvent.

end.description: Event end (UTC), not before the start.

all_day.description: true for an all-day event (no time of day).

category_id.description: Event category id; omit for no category.

waiver_form_ids.description: Waiver form ids for this event; omit or empty to attach all active forms.

tools.name: waiverfile_invite_event_managers
tools.title: Invite event managers
tools.description: SENDS EMAIL: invites people (by email address) to manage one event; they can log in to WaiverFile and see its signers and participants, with the fields set in the account settings. WaiverFile emails each address, with your optional message in the body (skip_email_if_account_exists suppresses the email for people who already have an account). Cannot be undone by this server except with the vendor's own remove-managers action. Requires confirm=true after the user approved it. POST /InviteEventManagers.

message.description: Optional message added to the invitation email.

skip_email_if_account_exists.description: Do not send the email to people who already have a WaiverFile account (default false).

confirm.description: Must be true: the user approved emailing these addresses and giving them access to this event's signers. Without it nothing is sent.

tools.name: waiverfile_create_event_category
tools.title: Create an event category
tools.description: Create an event category (a label to group events). Not idempotent: calling twice with the same name creates two categories. POST /InsertEventCategory.

active.description: Whether the category is active (default true).

prompts.title: Get started with WaiverFile
prompts.description: What you can do with WaiverFile here, with example requests to try.
